title: Wandering In Time
author: Nisha luthra
text:
Aren`t we all wandering in time
Collecting experiences
ticking clocks
beating hearts
A mere muse in the hands of divine
Sunsets on the shores of our hearts
Raindrops on the lines of our palms
Sunrise on the skylines so high
Deep within a black hole ,a coalmine
Merchandising memories
Negotiating the pale melancholy
Escaping vacuums
Evading connections
Accumulating world in a suitcase
Detachment attachments,
learning unlearning
Hiding abiding
Walking at your own pace
Moaning hugging
Making love to the new boundaries`
But not leaving behind the exchanged first kisses and deep magical glances
Aren`t we all wandering in time
Drunk under the myths of permanence
Knowing that whatever there is going to be left behind
Aren`t we all wandering in time
